description: Default governance rules for PBIR Design Analyzer. Organizations can override these via Configuration Panel UI (stored in VS Code globalState).

maxVisualsPerPage.name: Max Visuals Per Page
maxVisualsPerPage.description: Maximum number of visuals allowed on a single page/state

maxBookmarksPerPage.name: Max Bookmarks Per Page
maxBookmarksPerPage.description: Maximum number of bookmark states allowed per page

maxLayoutStatesPerPage.name: Max Layout States Per Page
maxLayoutStatesPerPage.description: Maximum number of distinct visual layout states (via bookmarks) allowed per page

maxHiddenVisuals.name: Max Hidden Visuals
maxHiddenVisuals.description: Maximum number of hidden visuals allowed (inactive visuals hidden by bookmarks)

minWhiteSpaceRatio.name: Minimum White Space Ratio
minWhiteSpaceRatio.description: Minimum ratio of white space to total page area (0.0 = 0%, 1.0 = 100%)

allowPieCharts.name: Allow Pie Charts
allowPieCharts.description: Whether pie charts are allowed in reports

allowCustomVisuals.name: Allow Custom Visuals
allowCustomVisuals.description: Whether custom visuals (third-party) are allowed in reports

requirePageTitle.name: Require Page Title
requirePageTitle.description: Whether page titles are required on all report pages

requireFilterPanel.name: Require Filter Panel
requireFilterPanel.description: Whether a filter panel is required on all report pages

themeStandard.name: Standard Theme
themeStandard.description: The approved standard theme for reports (e.g. 'default', 'executive', 'contrast')
